items.label: text
items.text: We have seen that when heat energy is supplied to solids,liquids and gases it increases thekinetic energy of theirmolecules,which we detect as an increase in temperature.Different substancesneed differentamounts ofheat energy to cause the sameincrease in temperature.

items.label: text
items.text: We define the specific heat capacity (s.h.c.),c,ofa substance as the amount ofenergyrequired toincreasethe temperature of 1kilogramof thatsubstance by1°C.The unit of s.h.c.is J/kg°C.
